visual_review.scope: Inspected synthetic XMP secondary timing windows on Debian 12, Ubuntu 24.04 and Rocky 8: all sixteen first-profile secondary ps/nCK rows, complete names, quantities and CRC status are visible. The second and third profiles are checked by Qt but are outside this screenshot viewport. Inspected the Ubuntu packaged memory page; native and release screenshots are byte-identical and include the updated scope without automatic inventory scanning.

preserved_original_document_difference.scope: Existing local UMC implementation link preserved in the original directory; All 14 changed files match the cloud archive in full; unrelated original document differences are retained.
